data.body:
Final report (rebar-debug, Phase 2 complete).

FIX MERGED: Gerrit change 2108 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2108), merge commit e6de02a70ec0, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1, submitted.

TEST (RED->GREEN, held out): two unit regression tests in tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py — test_every_arm_reports_its_declared_provider_family (parametrized over all three arms; anthropic/bedrock were green negative controls, openai RED) and test_the_openai_arm_is_live_ready_with_its_own_credential (RED: live_llm_ready() False). Both seen RED in final form before the fix, set aside as a patch while a held-out subagent implemented the fix from the contract card only, then re-applied and GREEN. Mutation check: commenting out the openai-chat->openai family map entry returned both to RED; restored.

FIX: tests/external/_live_llm.py gains _PROVIDER_FAMILY_BY_QUALIFIER ({openai-chat, openai-responses} -> openai) + provider_family(); configured_provider() now returns the provider FAMILY, so credential lookup, live_llm_ready(), skip reasons, and the guard's arm-equality all agree with REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER. tests/external/test_provider_matrix_live.py's two literal startswith comparisons now compare the resolved qualifier's family (unqualified strings still never pass). No src/ changes; the resolver's openai-chat canonicalization is the contract side.

GUARD KEEPS TEETH: pointing the openai arm at anthropic.toml still fails the class guard (verified locally) — the false-positive is gone, the true-positive remains.

REPLICATION: the original report's scenario (REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1, REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER=openai, REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE=.github/llm-providers/openai.toml, key present) now passes: 3 passed, 1 skipped (bedrock-region self-skip), and no 'openai-chat credential absent' skips — the arm will run the live suite again.

SIBLINGS (Step 7): construct sweep — no other literal qualifier-vs-family comparisons in tests/ or src/ (src handles openai-chat throughout: providers.py:105/153, capabilities.py:419, anthropic_model.py:40, config.py:233; unit tier has _MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER). Parity sweep — anthropic and bedrock arms verified locally under their overlays (3 passed / class guard passed); both now flow through the same provider_family() seam, so a future qualifier split is a one-line map entry. tests/external/_structured_matrix.py keys providers by toml filename stem (family names) — not affected.

SCOPE & SAFETY: caller sweep of configured_provider (live_llm_ready, _skip_reason, guard line 94) — all want the family; no behavioral dependency on the qualifier. Restoration not creation (restores the green-arm behavior of run 32000764439); no new dependency; no test weakened (assertions strengthened: separator now required).

RESIDUAL RISK: none observed beyond what was fixed; the openai-responses map entry future-proofs the announced pydantic-ai v2 direction (ticket 1d22).

CAUSED_BY: 1d22-40ba-8e2b-4f67 (commit 8f4c5fdb0d3) — recorded on the close with --class=regression.
